text: すごいつりざおは　ばしょを　かえると　つれる　ポケモンも　かわる！

structure.jp: ばしょを　かえると
つれる　ポケモンも　かわる！
structure.en: the Pokémon you can catch change too!

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. ばしょを　かえると = 'when you change the place'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' or 'which' in English. つれる　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon that you can catch'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: つる 'to fish' becomes つれる 'to be able to catch'. つれる = 'can be caught'.
